title: Connections: Medal Table
desc: Find the sporting thread linking each set

questions.q: What connects: Roger Federer, Rafael Nadal, and Novak Djokovic — beyond being tennis players?
questions.a: The 'Big Three' — they dominated men's tennis for nearly two decades, winning 66 of 79 Grand Slam titles between 2003 and 2023. Federer retired in 2022

questions.q: Odd one out: football, rugby, basketball, baseball. Which and why?
questions.a: Baseball — it's the only one where the defending team has the ball

questions.q: What connects: the black power salute (1968), Colin Kaepernick kneeling (2016), and the England football team kneeling (2020)?
questions.a: Athletes using their platform for racial justice protest — all were initially condemned by many, then increasingly supported over time

questions.q: Put these Olympic sports in order of when they were added: basketball, skateboarding, tennis, snowboarding
What connects: the yellow jersey, the green jacket, and the Claret Jug?
questions.a: Iconic prizes in their sport — Tour de France leader's jersey, the Masters golf champion's jacket, and the Open Championship golf trophy

questions.q: Two of these sports were invented in the same country. Which two? Basketball, rugby, cricket, volleyball
questions.a: Basketball and volleyball — both invented in the United States (Massachusetts specifically). Rugby and cricket are English

questions.q: What connects: Usain Bolt's 9.58, Eliud Kipchoge's 1:59:40, and Bob Beamon's 8.90m?
questions.a: All are iconic athletic records — 100m sprint, sub-2-hour marathon (unofficial), and long jump. Beamon's 1968 record stood for 23 years

questions.q: What's the connection: a shuttlecock travels faster than a tennis ball, a golf ball, and a baseball during play?
questions.a: True — badminton smashes have been recorded at over 400 km/h (the fastest racquet sport shot), though the shuttlecock decelerates rapidly due to drag

questions.q: What connects: the Rumble in the Jungle, the Thrilla in Manila, and the Fight of the Century?
questions.a: All are Muhammad Ali boxing matches — vs George Foreman (Zaire, 1974), vs Joe Frazier (Philippines, 1975), and vs Joe Frazier (New York, 1971)

questions.q: True, false, or it depends: 'Women weren't allowed in the Olympic marathon until 1984'
questions.a: True — Kathrine Switzer ran the Boston Marathon unofficially in 1967 (an official tried to physically remove her). The women's Olympic marathon was only added at the 1984 Los Angeles Games
